task_description: Convert the SMC-FVG concept into a TradingView Pine v5 strategy: create a new file smc_fvg_strategy.pine (title 'SMC - FVG Strategy | Emmanuel') that copies the structure + FVG-in-BOS/CHoCH engine from smc_fvg.pine and adds a trading layer. On a BOS/CHoCH confirmed at candle close, place a LIMIT order at each highlighted FVG's near (proximal) edge, with SL/TP in points (defaults 300/5000), handle multiple concurrent pending orders (hard cap 100), draw a permanent split-rectangle projection (TP zone + SL zone + dotted entry line), and reuse the Internal/Swing/Both selector as the single source of truth to enable/disable trades per structure type. Leave smc_fvg.pine untouched.
